topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: When my sister and I found out we were to inherit Grandma's house, the weight of what that meant really hit me. It's not just a house; it's a piece of our childhood, a place filled with so many memories. I can see us running through the rooms, the smell of her baking, her garden in full bloom. Now, we have to decide what to do with it. Selling seems practical, but it feels like letting go of a part of her. Keeping it means maintaining a link to our past, but at what cost? Each option brings its own set of challenges. I guess our next step is to sit down and talk about what Grandma would have wanted, and what's best for both of us moving forward.
